summary.en: Build desktop forms with Swing components, layout managers and event-thread ownership.
summary.bn: সুইং কম্পোনেন্ট আর লেআউট ম্যানেজার দিয়ে ফর্ম বানাও এবং EDT-তে জিইউআইর কাজ করো।

notes: All programs use Java 17 APIs and language rules.

sections.title: Build a window from cooperating components
Construct the interface on its event thread
Arrange a hierarchy rather than fixed coordinates
Keep actions short and move long work away
Make the form readable before adding decoration
Check containment and the event queue
Swing works within the Java 17 desktop module
Let layout and thread ownership guide the window

examples.title: A simple input row
examples.explanationHtml: The FlowLayout panel shows a label, text field and Find button. The button has no action yet.
examples.outputNote: A window titled Library desk shows Book id, an editable field and a Find button. Resize it to inspect FlowLayout.

examples.title: A nested borrowing form
examples.explanationHtml: The central grid arranges two labelled fields. BorderLayout keeps the heading and Borrow button around it.
examples.outputNote: A Borrow a book window contains two input rows and a Borrow button. Resize it and check that the grid stays aligned.

examples.title: A greeting preview
examples.explanationHtml: Clicking Show trims the name and changes the label on the EDT. The next lesson develops that listener pattern.
examples.outputNote: A Live preview window shows a text field, Show button and Waiting label. Enter Mita and click Show to see Hello Mita.

practice.title: Validate a name model
practice.statementHtml: Read one complete line, possibly empty. Strip surrounding whitespace. Print MISSING if empty; otherwise print Hello followed by one space and the stripped name. No prompt.
hints: Keep this rule independent of JTextField.

practice.title: Check a borrowing form model
practice.statementHtml: Read book id and member id (-10..999). Print READY if both are positive, otherwise MISSING. This console model creates no Swing window. No prompt.
hints: A visual width cannot validate an id.

practice.title: Choose a component hierarchy
practice.statementHtml: Design a borrowing form with two labelled fields and one action button. Name the layouts and justify them.
practice.answerHtml: Use BorderLayout on the frame, a central GridLayout panel with two rows and two columns, and a bottom FlowLayout panel for the button. The grid keeps field alignment while the outer layout distributes resizing space.
hints: Use a panel to group controls before placing it in a region.

practice.title: Move slow work off the EDT
practice.statementHtml: A button listener reads a huge file and freezes the screen. Propose a repair.
practice.answerHtml: Start a SwingWorker or another background task for reading. Keep the model result separate, then update Swing controls on the EDT. Disable or otherwise manage conflicting actions while loading.
hints: Painting and click processing share the EDT.

quiz.prompt: Which greeting should the model provide after trimming the entered name?
quiz.explanation: strip removes surrounding whitespace before the greeting is built.

quiz.prompt: Should the form model accept a zero book id?
quiz.explanation: The model requires both ids to be positive.

quiz.prompt: Which status text corresponds to two model increments?
quiz.explanation: The status derives from the model count rather than component geometry.

quiz.prompt: Which Swing type is the top-level window?
quiz.explanation: A frame supplies the desktop window around its content.

quiz.prompt: Which component accepts a single text line?
quiz.explanation: A label displays text, whereas a text field accepts editing.

options: To schedule component work on the EDT
quiz.explanation: Swing component ownership belongs to the event-dispatch thread.

quiz.prompt: What does pack use to choose an initial size?
options: Preferred sizes through the layout hierarchy
The number of Java source lines

quiz.explanation: GridLayout distributes space uniformly among its cells.

quiz.prompt: Why avoid long file reads inside a button listener?
options: They block EDT input and painting
quiz.explanation: A listener runs on the EDT and must return promptly.

quiz.prompt: Does a JTextField column count validate input length?
options: Yes, it rejects all longer input
quiz.explanation: Data validation needs a separate model rule.

pack কম্পোনেন্টের পছন্দের মাপ দেখে উইন্ডোর মাপ ঠিক করে।

examQuestions.question: Explain JFrame, JPanel, JLabel, JButton and JTextField in a form.
examQuestions.answerHtml: JFrame is the top-level window; JPanel groups controls; JLabel identifies fields or displays status; JTextField accepts one-line text; JButton starts an action through a listener.

examQuestions.question: Why do layout managers improve portability?
examQuestions.answerHtml: They use component sizes and container space rather than assuming fixed pixels. Different fonts, scaling and translated labels can still be arranged sensibly.

examQuestions.question: What belongs on the EDT and what should move away?
examQuestions.answerHtml: Creation and ordinary updates of Swing controls belong on the EDT. Slow file or network work should run in a worker, with its resulting display update sent back to the EDT.
